name: autosave
title: Autosave
description: Saves a form in the background 3 seconds after the user starts typing.

attributes.name: data-autosave
attributes.description: Enables autosave. The form's method and action are used for the request.

attributes.name: data-autosave-action="input->change"
attributes.description: Schedules a save when any field changes.

attributes.name: data-autosave-target="submit"
attributes.description: Disabled while saving. Add btn--busy to show a spinner.

actions.name: change
actions.description: Schedules a save 3 seconds later, unless one is already scheduled.

events.name: velle:autosave:success
events.description: The server answered with a 2xx status. event.detail.response is the fetch Response.

events.name: velle:autosave:error
events.description: The request failed or the server answered with an error. event.detail has response or error.

notes: The form is sent with fetch() as FormData (as query parameters for GET), with credentials: "same-origin" and the X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header.
If the page has <meta name="csrf-token">, its content is sent as an X-CSRF-Token header.
While saving, the form gets aria-busy="true".
A pending save is sent immediately when the form is removed from the page.
